english.title: Resist / wilfully obstruct an accredited financial investigator - Proceeds of Crime Act 2002
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) resisted or wilfully obstructed **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a financial investigator accredited under the Proceeds of Crime Act 2002, who was acting in the exercise of

(A)_[his]_
(B)_[her]_

powers as defined by section 453A(5) of that Act
english.legislation: Contrary to section 453A(2) and (4) of the Proceeds of Crime Act 2002.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) This offence was inserted by section 81 of the Serious Crime Act 2007.
(ii) Until the commencement of section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 the reference to 51 weeks in the penalty is to be read as a reference to one month. MoPI group cannot be established from the offence code alone. Group 2 or 3 may apply depending on the nature of the related crimes. Manual MoPI review is required.

other.penalty:
Summary: 51 weeks imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding level 3 on the standard scale.

Note:
Until the commencement of section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 the reference to 51 weeks is to be read as a reference to 1 month.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
